images.filename: Gulf of Corinth fault map with 1861 EQ epicentre.png
images.caption: Map of the Gulf of Corinth showing main active faults and 1861 Eliki earthquake epicentre. The base map is taken from the NOAA/NCEI Bathymetric Data Viewer using the GEBCO_2022 (NOAA/NCEI Visualization). The main active faults are taken from Bell et al. (2009) and the epicentre of the 1861 Eliki earthquake is taken from Albini et al. (2017)
